body.usage: Paragraphs, small labels, input text, chat bubbles

component_guidelines.navigation: Crystal glassmorphism (bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-stone-200) with language toggle and credit balance.
component_guidelines.language_toggle: Pill-shaped toggle (rounded-full). Active state: bg-[#064E3B] text-[#D4AF37]. Inactive state: text-[#44403C]. Include data-testid='language-toggle'.
component_guidelines.agent_mode_button: A tactile switch or prominent button in the chat header. When active, glowing effect with shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(212,175,55,0.4)] and text-[#D4AF37]. data-testid='agent-mode-toggle'.
component_guidelines.chat_bubbles: User bubble: bg-[#F3EFE6] text-[#1C1917], rounded-br-none. NaBaB AI bubble: bg-[#064E3B] text-[#FDFBF7], rounded-bl-none.
component_guidelines.model_selector: Bento-grid style cards. 'NaBaB Universe' is prominent, active (border-[#064E3B] ring-1 ring-[#D4AF37]). Locked models (GPT, Claude, Gemini) have opacity-60, grayscale filter, and a 'Coming Soon' badge in gold.
component_guidelines.custom_credit_input: Massive typography (text-5xl or text-6xl) with tracking-tighter, border-b-2 border-[#064E3B], bg-transparent focus:outline-none focus:border-[#D4AF37]. Price auto-calculates beside it in a muted tone.
component_guidelines.qr_payment_modal: Clean card (bg-[#FDFBF7]) with the QR code centered. Subtle use of bKash pink (#E2136E) or Nagad orange/red (#F7931E) ONLY on their respective logo SVGs, keeping the rest of the modal green/gold. Form inputs for transaction ID.
component_guidelines.admin_tables: Flat surface, no outer card shadow, just 1px border-[#EAE5D9]. Header row: bg-[#F3EFE6] text-[#44403C] uppercase tracking-wider text-xs.
component_guidelines.buttons: Primary CTA: bg-[#064E3B] text-[#D4AF37] hover:bg-[#047857] transition-all. Secondary CTA: border border-[#064E3B] text-[#064E3B] hover:bg-[#F3EFE6].

images.description: Abstract green and gold marbling texture. Use as a subtle backdrop for the hero section with a heavy cream overlay (e.g., bg-[#FDFBF7]/80) so text remains fully legible.

icons.instructions: Use lucide-react for standard icons (Lock, Bot, User, Check, AlertCircle). For bKash and Nagad logos, strictly implement them as pure SVG shapes within the code to ensure high-resolution without placeholders.

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: All buttons should have a slight translate-y-[-2px] and increased shadow. Color shifts must maintain APCA contrast.
interactions_and_motion.loading: Use a subtle pulsing gold dot or a sophisticated typing indicator, avoiding standard generic spinners.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the UI exclusively using pure HTML/Tailwind for the landing page to achieve the bento layouts and overlapping designs.
Use Shadcn UI for the dashboard and admin panel, but override default stylings to match the Light/Luxury theme (cream backgrounds, green borders).
Never use generic placeholder URLs for images. Use the provided hero background image.
For the bKash and Nagad logos, build inline SVGs. Do not use external image links for them.
Include both 'Cormorant Garamond' (or 'Noto Serif Bengali') and 'Outfit' (or 'Hind Siliguri') via Google Fonts in the index.html or global CSS.
Ensure 'Coming Soon' models are completely disabled and inaccessible to the user.
